- As a family member, I want my own profile so that my watch history doesn't mix with others
- As a parent, I want a PIN on my profile so that kids can't access my viewing history
- As a TV user, I want to quickly switch profiles so that family members can easily change who's watching

- [ ] Each profile has separate watch history and continue watching
- [ ] Profile-specific recommendations based on individual viewing
- [ ] Quick profile switcher accessible from all screens
- [ ] Profile avatars and customization options
- [ ] PIN protection option for individual profiles
- [ ] TV interface supports easy profile switching with remote

- Multiple files (10-15) but single service
- Database changes but no Docker/infrastructure
- No external integrations requiring research
- Familiar technologies already in the codebase
- Cross-cutting but not introducing new architectural patterns

   114→### Data Isolation Pattern

   118→```typescript
   119→// Pattern to implement

   148→   - Description: Each profile maintains separate watch history, continue watching queue, and viewing preferences

   152→   - Description: Global profile switcher component accessible from all screens via navigation header or settings menu
   153→   - Acceptance: User can open profile switcher from home, player, search, settings, etc. Switcher displays all profiles with avatars and names
   154→
   155→3. **TV-Optimized Profile Selection**

   157→   - Acceptance: User can navigate between profiles using remote directional buttons and select with remote OK button. Focus indicators clearly show selected profile.

   168→   - Description: Profile switching does not log user out of account

   119→// Pattern to implement

   122→  profile_id: string; // Add this to scope data

   133→  .eq('profile_id', currentProfile.id)

   140→- Queries always filter by active profile

   147→1. **Profile Data Isolation**
   148→   - Description: Each profile maintains separate watch history, continue watching queue, and viewing preferences
   149→   - Acceptance: Viewing content on Profile A does not affect Profile B's watch history or recommendations
   150→
   151→2. **Profile Switcher UI**
   152→   - Description: Global profile switcher component accessible from all screens via navigation header or settings menu
   153→   - Acceptance: User can open profile switcher from home, player, search, settings, etc. Switcher displays all profiles with avatars and names
   154→
   155→3. **TV-Optimized Profile Selection**
   156→   - Description: Profile switcher fully functional with TV remote control (d-pad navigation, select button)
   157→   - Acceptance: User can navigate between profiles using remote directional buttons and select with remote OK button. Focus indicators clearly show selected profile.

   161→   - Acceptance: Profile management screen allows editing name (text input) and choosing avatar from gallery

   164→   - Description: Optional 4-digit PIN lock for individual profiles to prevent unauthorized access

   168→   - Description: Profile switching does not log user out of account
   169→   - Acceptance: After switching profiles, user remains authenticated to main account. Only profile context changes, not auth session.
   170→

   172→   - Description: Recommendation engine uses profile's watch history and preferences, not account-wide data
